Critical gap density, quantifiers, upper and lower limsup boundaries are explicit. checker.py reproduces exact diagnostics but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The integrand has a natural diagonal singular set studied in existing numerical-quadrature literature. The sharp 2/3 power and 2/3 logarithmic threshold distinguishes genuine a.s. integrator reliability from simple convergence in probability, shows infinite excursions despite exact unbiasedness, and identifies where independent-redraw stratification is inadequate. Not a routine renaming or arbitrary finite computation.
